evidence: symbol `mbedtls_mutex_lock` — Uniform idiom everywhere: `if ((ret = mbedtls_mutex_lock(&x->mutex)) != 0) return ret;` ... critical section ... `if (mbedtls_mutex_unlock(&x->mutex) != 0) return MBEDTLS_ERR_THREADING_MUTEX_ERROR;` (e.g. `library/rsa.c:1239-1260`). Lock/unlock failures return `MBEDTLS_ERR_THREADING_MUTEX_ERROR` (`include/mbedtls/threading.h:25`) or `MBEDTLS_ERR_THREADING_BAD_INPUT_DATA` (`include/mbedtls/threading.h:23`) for a NULL mutex pointer (`library/threading.c:75-99`).
